facts.text: Design atmosphere: 21% O2 at 14.7 psia and 0.0 g.
PSI's ISS solid-material test tables stop at 22.2% O2.
In the 26-40% O2, 7-10.6 psia exploration band PSI holds 84 conditions, 0 of them solid-material flames.
Top-ranked investigations for this habitat: ACME BRE (91/100), FLEX (82/100).
Closest condition measured in orbit: FLEX at 21.0% O2 and 14.7 psia.
Oxygen margin of safety (NASA Eq. 1) for thin materials: mean -2.62 points, largest loss -3.9 points (Mylar).
A thin material rated at 1 g between 21.0% and 24.9% O2 passes the 1-g test for this air but could burn in reduced gravity at the largest loss measured.
The verified literature holds 153 records within 4 points of 21% O2 and 12 records at partial gravity, 8 of them from LUCI at 0.167 g.
PSI holds no partial-gravity combustion data.
